author: SingleBlackMom
body:
Name: SingleBlackMom (Previously corkscrew102)
Reason: Flying, Kill-Aura
Why I should be unbanned: It has been 3 and a half months since my ban, and I have served it quietly. I was banned because I thought I wasn't go to be playing Avicus/MC anymore, so I decided to make sure I wouldn't be able to play anymore, since I was kind of addicted. It was sort of a stupid thing to do, and I regret it now. I promise that I will not hack again and that I will be a positive part of the Avicus community.

title: SingleBlackMom Ban Appeal

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello corkscrew,

I have decided to accept your appeal and unban you from our servers since you have served a satisfactory amount of time as a banned user without ban evading or causing trouble on other platforms. However, if you are validly banned again, you will not have the chance to appeal your infraction again. Please make sure to read the updated rules (http://avicus.net/rules). Welcome back.

Regards,
Rinn | Senior Moderator
